The '''Icetromper Lake''' was a frozen lake located in the southern end of the [[Highmount Ridge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It was named after the groups of [[Icetromper/Legends|icetrompers]] that made their home in the area.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Icetromper Lake appears as part of the Highmount Ridge on Hoth in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
